defect: InstallSuperVersion now unrefs the old SuperVersion before ResetThreadLocalSuperVersions(), so a thread-local slot can hold the last reference and SuperVersionUnrefHandle locks the DB mutex while holding the ThreadLocalPtr mutex, deadlocking against a flush that holds the DB mutex and calls Scrape().
reason: Before the change the reset ran before old_superversion->Unref(); the change moved it after, and the fix moves it back before the unref.

defect: remote_compaction_worker_threads is only reserve()d and then written and read through operator[] beyond size(), which is undefined behaviour and trips the libstdc++ assertion.
reason: The added reserve-then-index code is exactly what the fix replaces with push_back and a size()-based loop.

defect: NextFromInput increments snap_refresh_cnt_ without bound and passes it to TimeToRefresh, which shifts snap_refresh_nanos_ left by 2*cnt, so after many refreshes the shift exceeds 64 bits (UBSAN failure).
reason: The same commit added the counter argument here and the unbounded shift in compaction_iterator.h; the fix removes the counter from this call.

defect: LevelIterator nulls prefix_extractor_ under total_order_seek, so a table reader created during a total-order seek is built without a prefix extractor and a later prefix seek on a hash index dereferences a null extractor.
reason: The ternary added by this change is what the fix reverts, moving the total_order_seek check to the Seek path instead.

defect: CheckMemtableFull calls imm->NumFlushed() on the write path without the DB mutex, racing with MemTableList::InstallNewVersion.
reason: The fix states #6177 introduced this data race and replaces the added NumFlushed() call with an atomic HasHistory().

defect: When the table is over its occupancy limit Insert allocates a detached ClockHandle even if handle == nullptr, so the handle is never returned or freed (memory leak and ever-growing detached_usage_).
reason: The detached-insert branch is new in this change and the fix restricts it to handle != nullptr.

defect: getMergedHistogram holds merge_lock while calling thread_value->Fold (which takes the ThreadLocalPtr mutex), while a dying thread's merge handler takes the ThreadLocalPtr mutex and then merge_lock, a lock-order inversion that deadlocks.
reason: getMergedHistogram was added by this change and the fix narrows merge_lock to exclude the Fold.

defect: prefix_start_ is a Slice pointing into the caller's seek target or into saved_key_, which are freed or overwritten later, so subsequent Next/Prev compare against dangling memory.
reason: The Slice member and its assignments were added here; the fix changes prefix_start_ to an owning IterKey.

defect: LogBuffer::AddLogToBuffer is declared variadic, so LogToBuffer cannot forward its va_list and calls AddLogToBuffer(format) with no arguments, making vsnprintf read garbage arguments (valgrind errors).
reason: The variadic declaration added here and its use in env.cc of the same commit are what the fix changes to take a va_list.

defect: DebugString appends the uint32_t max_column_family_ with std::string::append instead of converting it to decimal text, producing a wrong (or ill-formed) result.
reason: The added line r.append(max_column_family_) is the one the fix replaces with AppendNumberTo.

defect: The fix only changes the allow_compaction constructor parameter from uint64_t to bool to silence MSVC warning C4800; behaviour is identical.
reason: The uint64_t parameter converts to bool correctly and RocksDB's own MSVC build disables C4800, so this is a type cleanup rather than a functional defect.

defect: The new KeyMayExist test asserts value_found after a flush, which only passed because the same commit passed no_io into BlockReader's for_compaction parameter in table.cc, so the test encodes the buggy behaviour.
reason: Both the wrong expectation added here and the no_io argument bug in table.cc come from this commit, and the fix corrects both.

defect: Timestamp-aware GC compares ikey_.user_key with current_user_key_ after current_key_ has already been overwritten, so keys differing only by timestamp are never seen as new, and the header keeps the timestamp only as a Slice set when full_history_ts_low_ is non-null.
reason: The timestamp GC state added in this header and the comparison in compaction_iterator.cc of the same commit are what the fix restructures.

defect: seqno_time_cadence is computed as min_time_duration / kMaxSeqnoTimePairsPerCF, which truncates to 0 when preclude_last_level_data_seconds is under 100, and a cadence of 0 cancels the recording task, so no seqno-to-time data is recorded.
reason: The integer division was added in RegisterRecordSeqnoTimeWorker by this change and the fix rounds it up.

defect: The new ROCKS_LOG_DEBUG calls dereference txn (GetName, GetSnapshot) unconditionally, but DoInsert is also called with txn == nullptr from DBInsert, a null-pointer dereference.
reason: The logging lines were added here and the fix guards them with txn != nullptr.

defect: PrintStatsSummary increments cf_num_accesses by one per caller entry instead of adding num_accesses, so per-column-family access counts are wrong.
reason: The new file contains cf_num_accesses++ and the fix changes it to += num_accesses.

defect: The new DeleteFileRange test stores the size_t result of CountFiles() in int32_t variables, which breaks the clang -Werror build with an implicit narrowing conversion.
reason: The int32_t declarations were added here and the fix changes them to size_t to fix the clang build.

defect: kFlagMin is initialised in-class with std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max(), which is not a constant expression on the supported MSVC compiler, breaking the Windows build.
reason: The change replaced UINT_MAX with numeric_limits::max() and the fix replaces it with a plain constant to fix the Windows constexpr issue.

defect: OptimizeForLevel calls std::pow while only <math.h> is included, which fails to compile on clang/Mac (no member named pow in namespace std).
reason: The std::pow call is in this new file and the fix replaces it with a shift to fix the compile error.

defect: The new default argument std::map<std::string, Status> status = {} on VerifyDBFromMap makes tests fail under the supported GCC 4.8.1 compiler.
reason: The brace default argument was added here and the fix replaces it with an explicit std::map<std::string, Status>() to make the tests pass on GCC 4.8.1; the cause is compiler-specific.

defect: The two new prefix-bloom tickers are inserted in the middle of TickersNameMap although their enum values (24, 25) come last, so the public name map no longer follows enum order and consumers that index it by ticker get mismatched names.
reason: The out-of-order map entries added here are what the fix moves to the end of the map to restore enum order.

defect: The UDI wrapper returns early on any non-OK status (including Incomplete from a partitioned index, causing an infinite loop), adds its meta block only after the internal index finished so it is never written, and passes internal keys instead of user keys to the user-defined builder.
reason: All three behaviours are in the wrapper added by this change and are repaired in the fix's diff of this file.

defect: The new upper bound ASSERT_LE(rate_limiter_drains, elapsed / 100000) ignores that a partial last interval can also drain the limiter, making RateLimitingTest flaky.
reason: The assertion was added here and the fix relaxes it by one interval to account for the partial interval.

defect: The new CurrentFileModifiedWhileCheckpointing2PC test leaks the 100000 loop transactions, the named transaction txn and the TransactionDB txdb, failing valgrind.
reason: The leaking test was added by this change and the fix adds the missing deletes.

defect: The fix adds U suffixes and static_casts in test assertions to silence signed/unsigned comparison warnings under stricter-than-default MSVC warning settings.
reason: The comparisons are numerically correct and the fix targets warnings only under more strict MSVC settings than the project's default, so it is a warning cleanup.

defect: In direct IO mode with an internal buffer, the result slice starts at buf.BufferStart() without adding offset_advance, so reads at unaligned offsets return the wrong bytes.
reason: The internal_buf branch was added here and the fix adds offset_advance to the returned address.

defect: For compaction reads TryReadFromCache prefetches only readahead_size_ bytes even when n is larger, then returns a Slice of n bytes past the buffer contents (heap-buffer-overflow, checksum mismatch).
reason: The for_compaction branch was added by this change and the fix prefetches std::max(n, readahead_size_).

defect: FlushedFileCollector::ClearFlushedFiles clears flushed_files_ without taking mutex_, racing with OnFlushCompleted from background threads.
reason: The unlocked method was added here while every other accessor locks mutex_, and the fix adds the lock.

defect: write_buffer_count() returns a double expression implicitly converted to size_t, a possible-loss-of-data warning that breaks the Windows build with warnings as errors.
reason: The function was added in this new header and the fix adds the explicit conversion to fix the Windows build.

defect: GetReadableProperties returns {} for an unordered_map whose default constructor is explicit in some standard libraries, which fails to compile on some supported compilers (issue #80).
reason: The return {} line was added by this change and the fix replaces it with an explicitly constructed UserCollectedProperties{}.

defect: The new ConcurrentMergeWrite test passes the same MemTablePostProcessInfo to concurrent MemTable::Add calls from two threads, a data race reported by TSAN.
reason: The shared post_process_info was introduced in this test and the fix gives each thread its own.

defect: MemTable::Get short-circuits with NotFound whenever max_covering_tombstone_seq > 0, discarding merge operands already collected from newer data, so a key with merge operands above a range tombstone is wrongly reported missing.
reason: The short-circuit block was added by this change and the fix removes it.

defect: FinishInitDb restores expected values only when IsStateTracked(), so test_batches_snapshots runs skip the restore, and it restores after the compaction filter already captured the old expected-values mapping, which Restore() unmaps (segfault).
reason: The Restore block and its condition and placement were added here, and the fix drops the IsStateTracked condition and moves the compaction filter setup after it.

defect: FileOpGuard writes iostats_context.disable_iostats directly, which does not compile when NIOSTATS_CONTEXT is defined because iostats_context is not available.
reason: The guard was added by this change and the fix switches to the IOSTATS_SET_DISABLE macro.

defect: The new fprintf prints the int64_t found_count with %ld, a format mismatch that breaks the build where int64_t is long long (issue #303).
reason: The format string was added here and the fix replaces %ld with PRId64.

defect: ASSERT_LT compares the signed total_reads() with an unsigned uint32_t expression, a signed/unsigned comparison that fails the build with warnings as errors.
reason: The assertion was added in this change and the fix converts the left operand to uint32_t to fix the compile error.

defect: DBIteratorBoundTest allocates its iterate_upper_bound Slices with new and never deletes them, leaking memory under valgrind.
reason: The leaking new Slice calls were added here and the fix replaces them with stack Slices.

defect: When computing the file's largest key from range tombstones, only the first tombstone's end key is used, so a file with several tombstones gets a too-small largest_internal_key.
reason: The range-tombstone bound logic is new in this change and the fix also reads the last tombstone for the end key.

defect: TryReadFromCacheAsync no longer rejects offset < bufs_[curr_].offset_ when async_io_ is set, and the resulting prefetch path mishandles reads of earlier blocks, returning wrong data (checksum mismatch, iterator divergence).
reason: The relaxed guard was added by this change and the fix replaces it with a prev_len_-based check.

defect: GetPayload::cf_id and IterPayload::cf_id have no initialiser, and DecodeGetPayload/DecodeIterPayload set them only if the payload map has the CFID bit, so Replay can read an uninitialised cf_id.
reason: The payload structs were added here and the fix default-initialises cf_id to 0.
